$comment: The ONLY per-project file. Everything else is the reusable procedure. Retarget = copy .claude/ + playbooks/, edit this file.

product.name: CHANGE-ME
product.description: Holiday-rental site for a seaside apartment near Zadar, Croatia.

playbooks.$comment: playbooks/ is the source of truth. tools/sync.mjs projects it into each harness's skills dir as generated copies. Add a target and the same procedure reaches another tool; nothing in the playbooks changes.

source.$comment: kind: claude-design | library | manual. For claude-design, put the artifact URL or exported file here; for library, the import path of the component library.

prototype.$comment: One self-contained .html per requirement: React 18 UMD + Babel standalone, design-system tokens inlined, hash routing, every screen marked data-screen.

tracker.$comment: provider: files | jira. No playbook ever talks to a tracker directly — they shell out to tools/tracker.mjs, so swapping the provider changes nothing above this line.

jira.$comment: Fill in and set provider=jira. transport: mcp (an Atlassian MCP server) or cli (curl + JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN env).

gates.$comment: humanApprovesPrototype is enforced by gate.mjs approve, which refuses without --human-approved. It is the one gate that represents a person and the one that prose could never hold.

loops.$comment: After this many bounced reviews the story goes to blocked and asks the human. gate.mjs review counts the rounds and refuses the next one.

verify.$comment: Commands the implement phase must get green before a story leaves in-progress. Empty array = nothing to run (the procedure still works, it just proves less).
